financial_quality.judgment: Cash conversion remains strong despite the year-on-year CFO decline; recurring concession operations and volume growth support the defensive label.

market_implied_expectation.interpretation: At roughly low-teens normalized P/E, valuation is not demanding, but the current price leaves only ~12% probability-weighted price upside before dividend support, slightly below the system's 15% hurdle.

operating_and_capital.judgment: Liquidity and payout are supportive, but rising receivables, project capex and the H-share capital-markets process must be monitored for dilution and ROIC.

source_quality_note: Core H1 financial and cash-flow facts are anchored to the formal CNINFO report summary and full-report mirror; market price is from the completed 2026-09-15 session. Scenario EPS, multiples, probabilities and the entry gate are analytical assumptions.

军信股份2026年半年度报告全文

thesis.core: Waste-to-energy operations remain defensive and cash generative: H1 profit grew mid-single digits, CFO remained well above attributable profit and waste-processing/on-grid power volumes continued to rise.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use 2026 normalized EPS bear/base/bull of RMB0.95/RMB1.10/RMB1.20, anchored to H1 EPS RMB0.5507 and moderated for project timing, financing costs and cash-collection risk.
thesis.variant_wedge: The market underappreciates the durability of concession cash flows and payout capacity, but the current price is just above the system's 15% new-capital hurdle; the H-share listing process, new-project capex and receivable collection warrant a disciplined entry.

catalysts: Waste-processing and grid-power volumes continue growing without margin or collection deterioration.
The Changsha Hexi waste-to-energy project progresses at acceptable construction cost and expected ROIC.
H-share listing completes without materially dilutive economics for A-share holders.
Cash payout remains durable while leverage and interest burden stay controlled.
kill_thesis: Receivables and collection days worsen enough to break the current CFO-to-profit advantage.
H-share issuance or pricing materially dilutes A-share per-share value without a compensating ROIC uplift.
New-project capex and leverage grow faster than sustainable operating cash returns.
Tipping fees, tariffs or concession economics deteriorate materially.
